correctness.rationale: The join classification exhausts all pair counts of selected vertices and separates singleton-side from both-sides-at-least-two without overlap. Every possible omitted vertex is checked; converses are established. Disjoint union and cotree induction give the universal polynomial. The sharp bound follows by \(i(A)i(B)\le |A||B|\le\lfloor n^2/4floor\), with both equality conditions necessary and sufficient. Standalone exhaustive enumeration checks 6039 labeled cographs through order six, 1000 additional random cotrees through order twelve, and complete-bipartite coefficient anchors; finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The theorem determines each coefficient of the P3-convex-set cardinality polynomial for the natural P4-free class and exhibits a sharp transition from exponential counts in connected stars to a quadratic cap when universal vertices are absent, uniquely attained by balanced complete bipartite graphs. This structural classification is motivated by the 2026 counting problem and is not merely a generic tractability statement or a small finite table.
